text:
alex: Quick sync — product wants a compact cost badge on route list: show percent cache savings and small USD/token. Thoughts?

karen: Percent-first, USD/token secondary. Show a tiny "sampled" badge when data comes from sampled lineage.

devon: Telemetry: we need tokenized_input_count + sample_weight on enriched events. Recommend default sample_rate=0.5% for list view.

anna: UX: add confidence pill (low/med/high) based on CI; expand to see exact CI and token estimates. Hover explains sampling.

ops-bot: Deploy scheduled: feature/econ-badge -> staging 2024-10-07T09:00:00Z.

alex: OK I'll open three PRs: telemetry schema, econ-preview API, and Console badge + hover. We'll iterate after the first reconcile run.
